title: Cohomological descent and its spectral sequence for surjective finite scheme morphisms
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof constructs the augmented cosimplicial sheaf complex attached to the entire Cech nerve of a finite surjection. Exactness must be proved on geometric stalks by identifying the nerve with powers of a finite nonempty fibre, then finite pushforward acyclicity must be used to obtain the asserted descent spectral sequence.
